version.description: Changes exactly when the report does

kind.description: The kind of the part holding the check. Part of the slot

id.description: The check id. Part of the slot

specPath.description: The spec the check belongs to, `specs/<path>`, or null

detail.description: Why it has this status; empty when there is nothing to add

limit.description: The allowance, or budget. A measurement over it is reported, and never fails the check by itself

kind.description: What the number is, in an open vocabulary. `product-latency`: a user-visible response time between `from` and `to`. Absent: just a number, never read as product latency

from.description: The event the interval starts at. Without both `from` and `to` a latency is shown but no product claim is made from it

to.description: The event the interval ends at

intended.description: The interval the name of the measurement claims, when what was measured is only part of it. If `intended.to` differs from `to` (or `intended.from` from `from`) the measurement is shown as partial, never as the complete interval

from.description: The event the interval starts at: `end of speech`, `submit pressed`

to.description: The event the interval ends at: `audible response`, `confirmation visible`

outcome.description: `observed` (the default), `timeout` or `failed`. For anything but `observed` the value is how long the observation waited: at least that much, so it counts against a budget and is never dropped

instrumentation.description: The version or method of the measurement. A change of it between two sets of observations is disclosed when they are compared

labels.description: What the observation is comparable with: `device`, `build`, `network`. `device` and `build` group the observations and, when two groups differ in the others, the comparison says so

attemptStatuses.description: The status of each recorded try, in the order they were made. Absent when no try was recorded, and in reports written before this was recorded: a first try is then unknown, never assumed to have passed

artifactTags.description: Normalized tags of the attachments themselves, sorted and distinct. Absent when no attachment is tagged; never inherited from a check or run

videos.description: Its references to videos and who holds each. Absent when it has none, and in reports written before this was recorded

owner.description: Who holds it: `layer`, `check`, `attempt` or `step`. An open vocabulary: treat an unknown owner as a check

attempt.description: The retry attempt that holds it, or that holds the step that does

step.description: The name of the step that holds it

tags.description: The normalized tags of this attachment itself. Absent when it has none (and in documents of older servers)

recording.description: What identifies the bytes; references with the same value are one recording. Absent when it cannot be played

available.description: False when the reference names no bytes: no bundle key, address or inline text, or a bundle key that the layer's own bundle does not hold

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, when the report can tell: `not-in-bundle` is a file the layer names but does not hold (stored, then gone). An open vocabulary: treat an unknown reason as plain unavailable

scope.description: What this recording shows as its producer declared it: its own `scope`, else its attempt's, check's, part's or layer's. Absent: the scope is unknown, never live, physical or audible

surface.description: Where the product ran, in an open vocabulary: `browser`, `native-app`, `api`, `cli`…

deviceKind.description: What it ran on, in an open vocabulary: `simulator`, `emulator`, `physical`, `virtual-machine`, `desktop`… A simulator and a physical phone stay distinct values; they are filtered separately

syntheticData.description: True: the data was made up for the run. False: real data. Absent: unknown

dependencies.description: Whether what the product talks to was `scripted` (replies fixed in advance), `live` or `mixed`. An open vocabulary; absent is unknown

audioCaptured.description: True: the recording has real audio. False: it is silent. Absent: unknown

pacing.description: How time ran, in an open vocabulary: `paced` (slowed or scripted for a viewer), `real-time`. Absent: unknown

asserted.description: The boundaries the result actually asserts. Activity visible in a recording beyond them is not verified behavior

limitations.description: Known limits of what this evidence shows, in the producer's words

declaredBy.description: Who or what made this declaration: a tool, a team, a person

verified.description: The names of the fields above (`surface`, `deviceKind`, `syntheticData`, `dependencies`, `audioCaptured`, `pacing`) that something independent of the producer checked. Every other field is only declared

provenance.description: Where the declaration comes from and how to check it: a document, a CI step, a device log

rel.description: Why it is linked, in an open vocabulary: issue, run, trace, docs, source…

state.description: Only for a check of a `ui-state` or `ui-plan` part: its picture and the facts its producer declared under the `atlas.ui-state` extension. See the UI catalog guide. Never decides a result

kind.description: The kind of UI state the producer declared: `screen`, `overlay`, `loading`, `error`, `empty`… Open vocabulary

inventory.description: A `ui-plan` entry that names a surface of the product's inventory, not a state

screenshot.description: The check's picture: its `screenshot` attachment, else its first image

omitted.description: Why the producer left the bytes out

critique.description: Only for a check of a `critique` part whose `atlas.critique` extension can be read: the opinion of an automated reviewer. An opinion, never a result: it does not decide `status`, a slot or the gate. See the critics guide

entryKey.description: The catalog entry that was judged

imageSha256.description: The hash of the exact image bytes that were judged. When the entry's image changes, this critique judged an earlier image

version.description: Of the critic's own logic. A newer version replaces an older one

parameters.description: Everything else that explains the result: temperature, seed, the SHA-256 of the rubric

score.description: A finite number. `scale` says what it means

stateKind.description: The kind of UI state the score is relative to: `screen`, `overlay`, `loading`, `error`, `empty`…

percentile.description: Where the score falls among the project's scores of the same state kind, 0..100, higher is better

sampleSize.description: How many scores of that state kind the percentile is over

previousScore.description: The same entry's score for its previous image, from the same critic

id.description: Stable within the critique, so a reviewer can mark this finding valid or not

unit.description: `px` (pixels of the stored image) or `normalized` (0..1 of its width and height). Open vocabulary

recording.description: What became of the check's expected recording: uploaded, referenced, skipped, unresolved or not-applicable. Independent of `status`

fingerprints.description: Spec path to the fingerprint the layer recorded for it

id.description: The layer id: 64 lowercase hex digits, the SHA-256 of its content

backend.description: The backend it was read from; the one that sorts first when several hold it

producer.description: The suite or tool that made it. Part of the slot

recordedAtMs.description: When the checks ran, epoch milliseconds. The newest completed result wins its slot

sha.description: The commit it was recorded at. Provenance only

branch.description: The branch it was recorded on. Provenance only

environment.description: The client it checked, such as `ios`. Part of the slot

parameters.description: Other choices that make a result its own slot

freshness.description: `modified`: recorded from a checkout with uncommitted changes. `unknown`: origin not captured. Absent: clean

run.description: The execution the producer named for it (one local or manual invocation). Grouping and display only; never part of the slot

id.description: The execution's identity within a project, chosen by the producer: a UUID, a timestamped name. Layers with the same id are one run; it never changes after it is recorded

title.description: A human name for the run. Presentation only: it is not part of the identity and does not hide the commit or `freshness`

startedAtMs.description: When the execution started, epoch milliseconds

endedAtMs.description: When the execution ended, epoch milliseconds

recording.description: Where recorded timelines are read from, or null

attemptStatuses.description: The status of each recorded try, in the order they were made. Absent when no try was recorded, and in reports written before this was recorded: a first try is then unknown, never assumed to have passed

artifactTags.description: Normalized tags of the attachments themselves, sorted and distinct. Absent when no attachment is tagged; never inherited from a check or run

attempt.description: The retry attempt that holds it, or that holds the step that does

step.description: The name of the step that holds it

audioCaptured.description: True: the recording has real audio. False: it is silent. Absent: unknown

rel.description: Why it is linked, in an open vocabulary: issue, run, trace, docs, source…

recordings.description: How many of the recordings the layer expected were published. Absent: the layer declared no expectations, so its completeness is unknown, not complete

available.description: False when the backend could not be read; its results are then unknown, never passed

notices.description: What could not be read. A gate treats any notice as unknown, never as passed

totalLayers.description: Every layer read, whether or not it still wins anything

active.description: Always empty on a server; kept for viewers written for live spec runs
